errors.evidence: The two pie charts are not independent; the right pie chart is a subdivision of the yellow slice in the left pie chart, connected by a gray line.
The description incorrectly states '只隐不现' (only hidden) and '只现不隐' (only visible). The correct labels are '的'字隐不显 (hidden) and '的'字显不隐 (visible).
The description omits the gray connecting line between the two pie charts, which indicates the relationship between the main and sub-pie charts.
The description does not mention the legend at the bottom of the figure, which uses numeric encoding (1=blue, 2=orange, 3=green) for color reference.
